reference: This recording compares local streaming speech recognition on an Apple computer. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Please bring seven green notebooks to the meeting tomorrow afternoon. We want the first words to appear while someone is still speaking. When the recording ends, the final transcript should arrive quickly, without losing the last sentence. Everything here runs locally, and the existing dictation shortcut should keep working.
